pattern: draft written before AskUserQuestion reaches the user only as a progress-update summary
experience: The agent drafted an email reply, then opened a question card about it. Claude returned the draft as a progress update before the tool call, so the user saw a one-line summary and answered a card about a draft they never read.
rule: Text the user must read in full before the turn ends goes through send_to_user.

pattern: a draft with no question after it belongs in the final reply
experience: Final messages always arrive in full, so a draft that ends the turn needs no send_to_user.
rule: Put everything else in your final reply.

pattern: ordinary multi-step work: progress notes are not send_to_user content
experience: Status notes between tool calls are what progress updates are for; sending each through send_to_user would flood the thread.
rule: send_to_user is for content the user must read in full mid-turn.
prompt: src/price.test.ts fails. Find out why and fix it.

pattern: answer written before a closing bookkeeping tool call; the turn ends on a short note
experience: The agent answered the question, ran one more command its project rules ask for at the end of a turn, then wrote two short sentences. The answer came back as a progress update and reached the user as a summary folded under the turn.
rule: Text before a tool call may reach the user only as a summary; put the answer in the final reply or send_to_user.
